offering_description.value: Builds and sells single-family homes to first-time and move-up buyers in planned communities, largely built to order. Also provides mortgage and title services to its home buyers.

primary_services.value: mortgage origination; title and escrow services

customer_segment.value: B2C: first-time and move-up homebuyers, and retirees buying homes in its communities

revenue_model.value: product sales: sales of single-family homes and townhomes to buyers; interest or premiums: interest and fees on mortgage loans to home buyers through its mortgage subsidiary

value_chain_position.value: other: develops land and builds homes, sold directly to buyers in its communities; financial intermediary: originates mortgages and provides title services for its home buyers

geography_served.value: US regional: Arizona, Texas, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina and Tennessee

specialization.value: niche specialist: single-family homebuilding, with mortgage and title services supporting home sales

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales staff at community sales offices and model homes; own locations: model homes and sales centers in its communities; online: website listings and online home reservations for buyers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: building codes, zoning and environmental rules for construction, consumer lending and title rules for mortgage and title services
